name: Udyam Registration (MSME)
description: Online registration of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises to obtain a Udyam certificate and access schemes/incentives.
benefits: Priority credit, subsidies, tender preferences, easier compliance, scheme eligibility.
validity: Valid until cancelled/updated; revalidate as per rules.

faq.a: Yes, Aadhaar of the owner/partner/director is required for registration.
No government fee for Udyam registration.

ai_summary: Udyam is the free online MSME registration giving enterprises a certificate and scheme benefits.
ai_explanation: Udyam Registration replaces Udyog Aadhaar. Enterprises self-declare with Aadhaar, PAN, GSTIN, and investment/turnover data to get a Udyam certificate, unlocking credit, subsidies, and tender benefits. It is free and instantaneous.
